name: Jochebed
bio: Jochebed is the wife of the Levite Amram, and the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam (Exodus 6:20). During Pharaoh's decree to kill every Hebrew baby boy, she hid the newborn Moses for three months, then placed him in a basket coated with pitch and tar among the reeds by the Nile. Through her daughter Miriam's quick thinking, she was then hired as his nurse, allowing her to raise her own son until he was formally adopted by Pharaoh's daughter (Exodus 2:1-10).
